name: Vladimir Lenin
role: Bolshevik revolutionary and head of Soviet government (1917–1924)
summary: Lenin advocated proletarian revolution, Communist Party leadership and a transition toward a classless society. His later economic programme permitted controlled private trade and concessions while promoting cooperatives and state industry; he supported national self-determination and women’s legal and economic emancipation.
